017package org.apache.juneau.console;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
022
023/**
024 * Server half of a console card type: validates an authored card and returns its page-contract fragment.
025 * Rendering is never done here; the JS handler registered under the same {@link #type()} renders the fragment.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * A type with no registered handler uses the generic passthrough (JSON5 body becomes the fragment, markup body
029 * becomes a template), so most custom cards need only JS. Register a handler when the server must validate
030 * or enrich the body.
031 *
032 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
033 * <p class='bjava'>
034 *   <jk>public final class</jk> KpiCardType <jk>implements</jk> CardTypeHandler {
035 *     <ja>@Override</ja> <jk>public</jk> String type() { <jk>return</jk> <js>"kpi"</js>; }
036 *     <ja>@Override</ja> <jk>public</jk> JsonMap toFragment(CardSource <jv>src</jv>) {
037 *       JsonMap <jv>b</jv> = <jv>src</jv>.json();                                  <jc>// E-24 on bad JSON5</jc>
038 *       <jk>if</jk> (! <jv>b</jv>.containsKey(<js>"value"</js>))
039 *         <jk>throw</jk> <jv>src</jv>.error(<js>"type='kpi' requires 'value'."</js>);
040 *       <jk>return</jk> <jv>b</jv>;
041 *     }
042 *   }
043 *   <jc>// Registration (either):</jc>
044 *   ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.<jsm>create</jsm>().cardType(<jk>new</jk> KpiCardType()).build();
045 *   <jc>// or META-INF/services/org.apache.juneau.console.CardTypeHandler</jc>
046 * </p>
047 *
048 * @since 10.0.0
049 */
050public interface CardTypeHandler {
051
052   /**
053    * The type name this handler serves.
054    *
055    * @return The type name; must match {@code ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$} (E-21).
056    */
057   String type();
058
059   /**
060    * Validates the authored card and returns its contract fragment.
061    *
062    * @param source The authored card (attributes plus body).
063    * @return The fragment merged flat onto the card's base keys; must not contain a reserved key (E-23).
064    * @throws IllegalArgumentException via {@link CardSource#error(String, Object...)} on invalid input.
065    */
066   JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source);
067
068   /**
069    * Topics this card publishes without declaring them, for R-10. Default: none (the shell adds card:/cmd:).
070    *
071    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
072    * <p class='bjava'>
073    *   <ja>@Override</ja>
074    *   <jk>public</jk> List&lt;String&gt; implicitTopics(JsonMap <jv>card</jv>) {
075    *     <jk>return</jk> List.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"kpi.threshold-crossed"</js>);
076    *   }
077    * </p>
078    *
079    * @param card The card object from the page contract (base keys plus this type's fragment).
080    * @return The concrete topics (or {@code ns.name:*} patterns) the type's JS publishes for this card.
081    */
082   default List<String> implicitTopics(JsonMap card) { return List.of(); }
083
084   /**
085    * Roles this type accepts in {@code subscribes[].as}, beyond {@code refresh} and {@code params}.
086    * {@code null} (the default) means "unknown to Java": the Java validator skips E-44 and the JS check (E-JS-47) decides.
087    *
088    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
089    * <p class='bjava'>
090    *   <ja>@Override</ja>
091    *   <jk>public</jk> Set&lt;String&gt; acceptedRoles() { <jk>return</jk> Set.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"highlight"</js>); }
092    * </p>
093    *
094    * @return The accepted role names, or {@code null} if unknown.
095    */
096   @SuppressWarnings({
097      "java:S1168" // null means "unknown to Java" in the public API
098   })
099   default Set<String> acceptedRoles() { return null; }
100
101   /**
102    * {@code cmd:<id>} ops this type handles, beyond the shell's {@code refresh}, for E-43 on a ribbon {@code target}.
103    * {@code null} (the default) means "unknown to Java": the Java validator skips the check and the JS shell reports
104    * an unhandled op at runtime (E-JS-48).
105    *
106    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
107    * <p class='bjava'>
108    *   <ja>@Override</ja>
109    *   <jk>public</jk> Set&lt;String&gt; acceptedOps() { <jk>return</jk> Set.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"set-target"</js>); }
110    * </p>
111    *
112    * @return The handled op names, or {@code null} if unknown.
113    */
114   @SuppressWarnings({
115      "java:S1168" // null means "unknown to Java" in the public API
116   })
117   default Set<String> acceptedOps() { return null; }
118
119   /**
120    * Toolkit packs this card needs because of what its body declares, beyond the packs its type always needs.
121    * Unioned with the type's packs and the card's {@code requires=}.  Default: none.
122    *
123    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
124    * <p class='bjava'>
125    *   <ja>@Override</ja>
126    *   <jk>public</jk> List&lt;String&gt; requiredPacks(JsonMap <jv>body</jv>) {
127    *     <jk>return</jk> <jv>body</jv>.containsKey(<js>"terminal"</js>) ? List.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"terminal"</js>) : List.<jsm>of</jsm>();
128    *   }
129    * </p>
130    *
131    * @param body The card's body: this type's fragment, as {@link #toFragment(CardSource)} returned it.
132    * @return The pack names; each must be a registered pack.
133    */
134   default List<String> requiredPacks(JsonMap body) { return List.of(); }
135}
